repos.name: polyledger
repos.description: Resumable Polymarket indexer: CLOB market metadata plus on-chain trades from Polygon, in one DuckDB file you can query with SQL
repos.readme_snippet:
PolyLedger
A resumable indexer for Polymarket market metadata and on-chain trade data, backed by DuckDB.
PolyLedger pulls every market from the Polymarket CLOB API, streams every OrderFilled event from Polygon via Envio HyperSync, and writes both into a single DuckDB file you can query with SQL imme
